text: The ordinary people are the only true source of legitimate political power.
This movement is nothing more and nothing less than the voice of ordinary people.
It is the people, not the officials, who must decide the future of this country.
Power must be returned to the hands of the people who built this nation.
Our people are sovereign and no authority stands above them.
Entrenched insiders block every reform that would help ordinary families.
A corrupt elite has captured our institutions and turned them against the public.
Bankers, lobbyists and career politicians have rigged the system against you.
The people in power have betrayed the country they were elected to serve.
They enrich themselves while the rest of the country is told to sacrifice.
